summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend (Expo web preview) testing of CricLive app. 36/36 pytest backend tests passed (100%). Frontend mobile (390x844) flows verified end-to-end: home loads with 7 match cards + AI promo, match detail opens with all 6 tabs (summary/scorecard/commentary/stats/fantasy/chat), scorecard & chat render correctly, Ask AI returns a real Claude Sonnet 4.5 response about Virat Kohli's IPL average (38.67), community has 3 polls and voting works after auth, registration flow creates user and navigates to authed profile with logout button + Following sections. Auth, follow/unfollow, alerts, polls vote, chat persist, AI win-probability (sums to 100) and all match detail endpoints (manhattan, partnerships, predicted-xi) all functional.

minor.issue: Mock data inconsistency: for a live IPL match, match header shows MI 77/3 (12.5 ov) with 'CSK – Yet to bat' and target 198, but the scorecard endpoint returns innings1 total 324/5 (MI batting first?). Header score_a/score_b and scorecard innings totals should reconcile for demo credibility.

issues: Score shown at top of match detail does not match scorecard innings totals (data-side issue in mock_data.py, surfaces in UI).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — cosmetic only.
Expo warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode' in expo logs — cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional) Fix mock_data so the live match's header score_a/score_b are consistent with scorecard innings1/innings2 totals to avoid demo confusion.
(Optional) Replace deprecated style.resizeMode on Image and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to silence RN warnings.

(Optional) Package versions flagged by Expo: @react-native-async-storage/async-storage 3.0.2 (expected 2.2.0), expo-font 55.0.6 (~14.0.11), react-native-svg 15.15.4 (15.12.1). Currently non-blocking but should be aligned before store submission.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (484 lines) is fine for now but approaching size where splitting routers (auth, matches, ai, community) would help.
/api/ai/ask does not require auth — acceptable for demo but consider rate-limiting in prod to prevent abuse of Emergent LLM key.
try_sportmonks result is fetched but never used (fallback always returns mock). Either remove the call (saves latency) or actually transform+return Sportmonks data when available.

get_current_user returns the user dict without filtering; response_model=UserOut filters at FastAPI layer for /auth/me but raw dict is used in other endpoints (harmless since _id is already excluded at fetch time). Good.
MongoDB _id properly excluded everywhere via projection {'_id': 0}.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (home, match detail + all 6 tabs, AI ask, community polls vote, register→authed profile)

seed_data_creation: Registered ephemeral user uitest+<random>@cric.live via UI and testfan+<random>@cric.live via pytest. Posted one TEST_ prefixed chat message. No cleanup needed as IDs are random per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. All endpoints under /api prefix. Mock data IDs are deterministic - first live match from /api/matches/live is reusable. To test AI, allow ~5-10s timeout; it calls Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent key. testIDs are present for all major interactive elements — see grep results in test report.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues. The only flagged item (scorecard/header score mismatch) is a mock-data coherence issue, not a functional defect — endpoints return structurally valid responses.
